tool.name: Pixelizer – Images
tool.description: Create images with the connected image providers, with reference images and a gallery.
tool.long_description: Creates images with the image providers connected in OmniWrench (Settings > AI assistants): OpenAI, Gemini, xAI, Black Forest Labs, fal.ai, Replicate, Stability AI, Ideogram, Recraft, MiniMax and local ComfyUI/LocalAI. Optionally with up to four reference images. The gallery shows the images of the AI data storage; images can be copied, opened, deleted or attached to the chat panel.
img.no_bot: No provider for images is connected yet. Images can be created with e.g. OpenAI (API key or sign-in with ChatGPT), Google Gemini, xAI, Black Forest Labs, fal.ai, Replicate, Stability AI, Ideogram, Recraft and MiniMax. Set up connections under Settings > AI assistants.
img.prompt_hint: What should the image show? Style, colours, lighting, text in the image …
img.no_refs: This provider does not accept reference images.
img.need_prompt: Please describe what the image should show first.
img.cost_hint: Each image may cost money at the provider. The description is sent to the provider without pseudonymization; images are stored unencrypted in the images folder of the AI data storage.
img.select: Select an image to show it here.
install.ready: Installed. Assistants are managed under Settings > AI assistants.
install.choose_text: Which optional parts should be installed now?
install.later: Can be installed later in the tool.
install.part_failed: Not installed ({error}). The tool offers it again.
